01 — THE STARTING POINT1 / 11
↗

It starts with a URL.

You enter a web address. Your browser reads the protocol, hostname, and path — then needs an IP address to find its destination.

THINK OF IT LIKE

Writing an address on an envelope. You know the name of the place, but first you need to find it on the map.

UNDER THE HOODURL
protocol  https:
host      www.example.com
path      /hello
This is a teaching simulation. No network request is sent.
THE BIG PICTURE

Find it. Connect. Ask. Receive.

DNS finds an IP address. HTTPS secures the connection. HTTP carries the request and response. Your browser turns the response into a page.

DNS address bookTLS privacy + identityHTTP conversation
